name: Standard Sales Order Processing (Happy Path)
trigger: Inbound SOAP message matching SalesOrder condition route {{Glovia_Route_SalesOrder}}
expected_outcome: Message enriched with default headers, routed via SequenceFlow_82, transformed via Test_Mapping, processed through Generic Headers, and successfully completes at EndEvent_2
validates: Content Modifier (CallActivity_4), ParallelGateway_74, ExclusiveGateway_80 (Route 1), Message Mapping (CallActivity_102), Generic Header Groovy script (CallActivity_13), and EndEvent_2

name: Sales Order Return Processing (Happy Path)
trigger: Inbound SOAP message matching Return condition route {{Glovia_Route2_ReturnSalesOrder}}
expected_outcome: Message enriched with default headers, routed via SequenceFlow_113, processes Generic Headers without mapping, and successfully terminates at EndEvent_9
validates: Content Modifier (CallActivity_4), ExclusiveGateway_80 (Route 2), Generic Header Groovy script (CallActivity_71), and EndEvent_9

name: Unmatched Routing Condition - Escalation End
trigger: Inbound SOAP message where neither SalesOrder nor Return condition evaluates to true
expected_outcome: Message routes to default path SequenceFlow_110 and terminates at EndEvent_11 with Escalation code RoutingConditionNotMet
validates: ExclusiveGateway_80 default path handling and EndEvent_11 escalation error event trigger

name: Mapping Failure Triggers Exception Subprocess
trigger: Inbound SOAP message on SalesOrder route containing invalid payload that triggers transformation error in CallActivity_102
expected_outcome: Exception Subprocess 1 caught by StartEvent_92, restores payload from ${property.InputPayload} in CallActivity_97, logs payload via Log_Payload.gsh in CallActivity_100, and terminates at EndEvent_95
validates: SubProcess_91 execution, property restoration from InputPayload, Groovy script logging attachment, and EndEvent_95 error termination

name: SOAP Boundary Condition - Exceeded Payload Size
trigger: Inbound SOAP message exceeding maximumBodySize limit of 40MB configured on SOAP sender adapter
expected_outcome: Immediate HTTP 413 or SOAP Fault rejected by CXF runtime before hitting StartEvent_2
